sotāyatanañca upalabbhati … ghānāyatanañca upalabbhati … jivhāyatanañca upalabbhati … kāyāyatanañca upalabbhati … rūpāyatanañca upalabbhati … saddāyatanañca upalabbhati … gandhāyatanañca upalabbhati … rasāyatanañca upalabbhati … phoṭṭhabbāyatanañca upalabbhati … manāyatanañca upalabbhati … dhammāyatanañca upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthena …pe….

sotadhātu ca upalabbhati … ghānadhātu ca upalabbhati … jivhādhātu ca upalabbhati … kāyadhātu ca upalabbhati … rūpadhātu ca upalabbhati … saddadhātu ca upalabbhati … gandhadhātu ca upalabbhati … rasadhātu ca upalabbhati … phoṭṭhabbadhātu ca upalabbhati … cakkhuviññāṇadhātu ca upalabbhati … sotaviññāṇadhātu ca upalabbhati … ghānaviññāṇadhātu ca upalabbhati … jivhāviññāṇadhātu ca upalabbhati … kāyaviññāṇadhātu ca upalabbhati … manodhātu ca upalabbhati … manoviññāṇadhātu ca upalabbhati … dhammadhātu ca upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthena …pe….

sotindriyañca upalabbhati … ghānindriyañca upalabbhati … jivhindriyañca upalabbhati … kāyindriyañca upalabbhati … manindriyañca upalabbhati … jīvitindriyañca upalabbhati … itthindriyañca upalabbhati … purisindriyañca upalabbhati … sukhindriyañca upalabbhati … dukkhindriyañca upalabbhati … somanassindriyañca upalabbhati … domanassindriyañca upalabbhati … upekkhindriyañca upalabbhati … saddhindriyañca upalabbhati … vīriyindriyañca upalabbhati … satindriyañca upalabbhati … samādhindriyañca upalabbhati … paññindriyañca upalabbhati … anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca upalabbhati … aññindriyañca upalabbhati … aññātāvindriyañca upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenāti?
Hañci puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthena, aññātāvindriyañca upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthena, tena vata re vattabbe—
‘puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthena, aññātāvindriyañca upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthena’, no ca vattabbe—

‘paccuppannaṃ atthi atthi siyā paccuppannaṃ, siyā no paccuppannaṃ, tena paccuppannaṃ no paccuppannaṃ, no paccuppannaṃ paccuppannan’”ti micchā.

na tassa saṅkhā ‘atthī’ti, na tassa saṅkhā ‘ahosī’ti.

na tassa saṅkhā ‘ahosī’ti, na tassa saṅkhā ‘bhavissatī’ti.

“catunnaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ natthi koci pāṭibhogo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ.
‘Jarādhammo mā jīrī’ti natthi koci pāṭibhogo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ.

yāni kho pana tāni pubbe katāni pāpakāni kammāni saṅkilesikāni ponobbhavikāni sadarāni dukkhavipākāni āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyāni, ‘tesaṃ vipāko mā nibbattī’ti natthi koci pāṭibhogo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ.
Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ dhammānaṃ natthi koci pāṭibhogo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmin”ti.
Hañci atītaṃ niruddhaṃ anāgataṃ ajātaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“ahaṃ kho, āvuso nigaṇṭhā, pahomi aniñjamāno kāyena, abhāsamāno vācaṃ, satta rattindivāni ekantasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedī viharitun”ti.
Tāya tāyeva natthi dukkhassantakiriyā, natthi vaṭṭupacchedo, natthi anupādāparinibbānanti?
Tāya tāyeva natthi dukkhassantakiriyā, natthi vaṭṭupacchedo, natthi anupādāparinibbānanti?
Tāya tāyeva natthi dukkhassantakiriyā, natthi vaṭṭupacchedo, natthi anupādāparinibbānanti?
Tāya tāyeva natthi dukkhassantakiriyā, natthi vaṭṭupacchedo, natthi anupādāparinibbānanti?
Tāya tāyeva natthi dukkhassantakiriyā, natthi vaṭṭupacchedo, natthi anupādāparinibbānanti?
Tassa tasseva natthi dukkhassantakiriyā, natthi vaṭṭupacchedo, natthi anupādāparinibbānanti?
Rūpaṃ parinipphannaṃ, rūpassa bhedo atthi, antaradhānaṃ atthīti?
Maraṇaṃ parinipphannaṃ, maraṇassa bhedo atthi, antaradhānaṃ atthīti?
Viññāṇaṃ parinipphannaṃ, viññāṇassa bhedo atthi, antaradhānaṃ atthīti?
Maraṇaṃ parinipphannaṃ, maraṇassa bhedo atthi, antaradhānaṃ atthīti?

Anusayā abyākatā, ahetukā, cittavippayuttā, aññāṇe vigate ñāṇī, ñāṇaṃ cittavippayuttaṃ, yattha sadde ñāṇaṃ pavattati, iddhibalena samannāgato kappaṃ tiṭṭheyya, cittasantati samādhi, dhammaṭṭhitatā, aniccatāti.
Sattamabhaviko puggalo nirayaṃ upapajjeyya, tiracchānayoniṃ upapajjeyya, pettivisayaṃ upapajjeyyāti?
Tena hi sattamabhavikassa puggalassa pahīnā duggatīti.

Saṃvaro kammaṃ tatheva asaṃvaro, sabbakammaṃ savipākaṃ, saddo vipāko, saḷāyatanaṃ vipāko, sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatāniyato, kolaṅkolapuggalo kolaṅkolatāniyato, ekabījī puggalo ekabījitāniyato, diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggati, tatheva sattamabhavikassāti.
“idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti …pe…
na nimittaggāhī hoti, sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe…
Rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā apariyāpannā vipākābyākatā cetanā savipākāti?
Hañci vipākābyākatā cetanā avipākā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci kiriyābyākatā cetanā avipākā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā apariyāpannā vipākābyākatā cetanā avipākāti?
Hañci apariyāpannā vipākābyākatā cetanā avipākā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā kiriyābyākatā cetanā avipākāti?
Hañci arūpāvacarā kiriyābyākatā cetanā avipākā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“nāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā byantibhāvaṃ vadāmi, tañca kho diṭṭheva dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye”ti.

Sukhavedaniyo dukkhavedaniyo adukkhamasukhavedaniyo, sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayutto, phassena sampayutto, vedanāya sampayutto, saññāya sampayutto, cetanāya sampayutto, cittena sampayutto, sārammaṇo;
atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhīti?
nanu na sukhavedaniyo na dukkhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Hañci na sukhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Phasso vipāko, phasso sukhavedaniyo …pe… sārammaṇo, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Saddo vipāko, saddo sukhavedaniyo …pe… sārammaṇo, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Saddo vipāko, saddo na sukhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Phasso vipāko, phasso na sukhavedaniyo, na dukkhavedaniyo …pe… anārammaṇo, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
“so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā brahmassaro hoti karavikabhāṇī”ti.
Sukhavedaniyaṃ dukkhavedaniyaṃ …pe… sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
nanu na sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Hañci na sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Cakkhāyatanaṃ vipāko, cakkhāyatanaṃ sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Cakkhāyatanaṃ vipāko, cakkhāyatanaṃ na sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
nanu na sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Hañci na sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Kāyāyatanaṃ vipāko, kāyāyatanaṃ sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
kāyāyatanaṃ vipāko, kāyāyatanaṃ na sukhavedaniyaṃ …pe… anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Hañci saḷāyatanaṃ kammassa katattā uppannaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
Atthi so niyamo yena niyamena sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatāniyatoti?
bojjhaṅgā yehi bojjhaṅgehi sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatāniyatoti?
Natthi so niyamo yena niyamena sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatāniyatoti?
Hañci natthi so niyamo yena niyamena sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatāniyato, no ca vata re vattabbe—
bojjhaṅgā yehi bojjhaṅgehi sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatāniyatoti?
Hañci natthi te bojjhaṅgā yehi bojjhaṅgehi sattakkhattuparamo puggalo sattakkhattuparamatāniyato, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Ye keci sotāpattiniyāmaṃ okkamanti, sabbe te sattakkhattuparamatāniyatāti?
Hañci so sattakkhattuparamo, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci so kolaṅkolo, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci so ekabījī, tena vata re vattabbe—
Diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyyāti?
Diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sañcicca mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya …pe…
Diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyyāti?
Hañci diṭṭhisampanno puggalo satthari sagāravo, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sikkhāya sagāravo, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Diṭṭhisampanno puggalo buddhathūpe ohadeyya omutteyya niṭṭhubheyya buddhathūpe apabyāmato kareyyāti?
Diṭṭhisampanno puggalo sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyyāti?
evameva kho, bhikkhave, yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetupi nātikkamantī”ti.
Hañci diṭṭhisampanno puggalo āpāyike rūpe rajjeyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—
amanussitthiyā tiracchānagatitthiyā nāgakaññāya methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, ajeḷakaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, hatthigavassavaḷavaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya …
Hañci diṭṭhisampanno puggalo tittiravaṭṭakamorakapiñjaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggati, diṭṭhisampanno puggalo āpāyike rūpe rajjeyyāti?
Arahato pahīnā duggati, arahā āpāyike rūpe rajjeyyāti?
diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggati, diṭṭhisampanno puggalo āpāyike sadde …
Arahato pahīnā duggati, arahā tittiravaṭṭakamorakapiñjaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyyāti?
Arahato pahīnā duggati, na ca arahā āpāyike rūpe rajjeyyāti?
Diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggati, na ca diṭṭhisampanno puggalo āpāyike rūpe rajjeyyāti?
arahato pahīnā duggati, na ca arahā āpāyike sadde …pe…
amanussitthiyā tiracchānagatitthiyā nāgakaññāya methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, ajeḷakaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, hatthigavassavaḷavaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya …pe…
Diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggati, na ca diṭṭhisampanno puggalo tittiravaṭṭakamorakapiñjaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyyāti?
Tena hi diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa pahīnā duggatīti.
Hañci taṇhā dukkhasamudayo vutto bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu lobho dukkhasamudayo vutto bhagavatā, dhammataṇhā lobhoti?
Hañci lobho dukkhasamudayo vutto bhagavatā, dhammataṇhā lobho, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci sā dhammataṇhā, tena vata re vattabbe—

Kappaṭṭho kappaṃ tiṭṭheyya, kappaṭṭho kusalaṃ cittaṃ na paṭilabheyya, anantarāpayutto puggalo sammattaniyāmaṃ okkameyya, niyato niyāmaṃ okkamati, nivuto nīvaraṇaṃ jahati, sammukhībhūto saṃyojanaṃ jahati, jhānanikanti, asātarāgo, dhammataṇhā abyākatā, dhammataṇhā na dukkhasamudayoti.
Kappo ca saṇṭhāti buddho ca loke uppajjatīti?
Kappo ca saṇṭhāti saṅgho ca bhijjatīti?
Kappo ca saṇṭhāti kappaṭṭho ca kappaṭṭhiyaṃ kammaṃ karotīti?
Kappo ca saṇṭhāti kappaṭṭho ca puggalo kālaṃ karotīti?
Atītaṃ kappaṃ tiṭṭheyya, anāgataṃ kappaṃ tiṭṭheyyāti?
Dve kappe tiṭṭheyya … tayo kappe tiṭṭheyya … cattāro kappe tiṭṭheyyāti?
Kappaṭṭhena chandiddhipādo bhāvito vīriyiddhipādo bhāvito cittiddhipādo bhāvito vīmaṃsiddhipādo bhāvitoti?
Hañci kappaṭṭho dānaṃ dadeyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci kappaṭṭho cetiyaṃ abhidakkhiṇaṃ kareyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu taṃ kammaṃ payuttaṃ kukkuccaṃ uppāditaṃ vippaṭisāriyaṃ janitanti?
Hañci taṃ kammaṃ payuttaṃ kukkuccaṃ uppāditaṃ vippaṭisāriyaṃ janitaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Mātā jīvitā voropitā … pitā jīvitā voropito … arahā jīvitā voropito … duṭṭhena cittena tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppāditaṃ … saṅgho bhinnoti?
Anantarāpayutto puggalo taṃ kammaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā kukkuccaṃ paṭivinodetvā vippaṭisāriyaṃ paṭivinetvā abhabbo sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamitunti?
Mātā jīvitā voropitā … pitā jīvitā voropito …pe…
Anantarāpayutto puggalo taṃ kammaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā kukkuccaṃ paṭivinodetvā vippaṭisāriyaṃ paṭivinetvā abhabbo sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamitunti?
Nanu taṃ kammaṃ paṭisaṃhaṭaṃ kukkuccaṃ paṭivinoditaṃ vippaṭisāriyaṃ paṭivinītanti?
Hañci taṃ kammaṃ paṭisaṃhaṭaṃ kukkuccaṃ paṭivinoditaṃ vippaṭisāriyaṃ paṭivinītaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“anantarāpayutto puggalo taṃ kammaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā kukkuccaṃ paṭivinodetvā vippaṭisāriyaṃ paṭivinetvā abhabbo sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamitun”ti.
Hañci taṃ kammaṃ payutto āsi, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Micchattaniyato sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamati, sammattaniyato micchattaniyāmaṃ okkamatīti?
Pubbe maggaṃ bhāvetvā pacchā niyāmaṃ okkamatīti?
pubbe sotāpattimaggaṃ bhāvetvā pacchā sotāpattiniyāmaṃ okkamatīti?
sammappadhānaṃ … iddhipādaṃ … indriyaṃ … balaṃ … bojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvetvā pacchā niyāmaṃ okkamatīti?
Bhabbo bodhisatto tāya jātiyā dhammaṃ nābhisametunti?
Ratto rāgaṃ jahati, duṭṭho dosaṃ jahati, mūḷho mohaṃ jahati, kiliṭṭho kilese jahatīti?
rāgena rāgaṃ jahati, dosena dosaṃ jahati, mohena mohaṃ jahati, kilesehi kilese jahatīti?
Kusalākusalā sāvajjānavajjā hīnapaṇītā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantīti?
Kusalākusalā sāvajjānavajjā hīnapaṇītā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantīti?
idaṃ paṭhamaṃ suvidūravidūraṃ …pe… tasmā sataṃ dhammo asabbhi ārakā”ti.
“so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmetī”ti.
“tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati …pe…
Ratto rāgaṃ jahati, duṭṭho dosaṃ jahati, mūḷho mohaṃ jahati, kiliṭṭho kilese jahatīti?
rāgena rāgaṃ jahati, dosena dosaṃ jahati, mohena mohaṃ jahati, kilesehi kilese jahatīti?
Kusalākusalā sāvajjānavajjā hīnapaṇītā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantīti?
idaṃ paṭhamaṃ suvidūravidūraṃ …pe… tasmā sataṃ dhammo asabbhi ārakā”ti.
“tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati …pe…

Tena phassena taṃ phassaṃ phusati, tāya vedanāya taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti, tāya saññāya taṃ saññaṃ sañjānāti, tāya cetanāya taṃ cetanaṃ ceteti, tena cittena taṃ cittaṃ cinteti, tena vitakkena taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi, tena vicārena taṃ vicāraṃ vicāreti, tāya pītiyā taṃ pītiṃ piyāyati, tāya satiyā taṃ satiṃ sarati, tāya paññāya taṃ paññaṃ pajānātīti?
Kusalākusalā sāvajjānavajjā hīnapaṇītā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantīti?
Kusalākusalā sāvajjānavajjā hīnapaṇītā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantīti?
idaṃ paṭhamaṃ suvidūravidūraṃ …pe… tasmā sataṃ dhammo asabbhi ārakā”ti.
“kusalākusalā sāvajjānavajjā hīnapaṇītā kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā sammukhībhāvaṃ āgacchantī”ti.
“idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, so taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati;
catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati, so taṃ assādeti taṃ nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjatī”ti.
Tena hi samāpanno assādeti, jhānanikanti jhānārammaṇāti.
Dukkhābhinandino sattā, atthi keci dukkhaṃ patthenti pihenti esanti gavesanti pariyesanti, dukkhaṃ ajjhosāya tiṭṭhantīti?
nanu sukhābhinandino sattā, atthi keci sukhaṃ patthenti pihenti esanti gavesanti pariyesanti, sukhaṃ ajjhosāya tiṭṭhantīti?
Hañci sukhābhinandino sattā, atthi keci sukhaṃ patthenti pihenti esanti gavesanti pariyesanti, sukhaṃ ajjhosāya tiṭṭhanti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Dukkhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, sukhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anusetīti?
nanu sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anusetīti?
Hañci sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“so evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vedayati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
Hañci taṇhā akusalā vuttā bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu lobho akusalo vutto bhagavatā, dhammataṇhā lobhoti?
Hañci lobho akusalo vutto bhagavatā, dhammataṇhā lobho, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci sā dhammataṇhā, tena vata re vattabbe—
Yā akusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sāva kusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
“yā akusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sāva kusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī”ti?
nanu kusalaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
Hañci kusalaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci kusalaṃ yoniso manasikaroto uppajjati, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Kāmasaññāya anantarā nekkhammasaññā uppajjati, byāpādasaññāya anantarā abyāpādasaññā uppajjati, vihiṃsāsaññāya anantarā avihiṃsāsaññā uppajjati, byāpādassa anantarā mettā uppajjati, vihiṃsāya anantarā karuṇā uppajjati, aratiyā anantarā muditā uppajjati, paṭighassa anantarā upekkhā uppajjatīti?
Yā kusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sāva akusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
“yā kusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sāva akusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī”ti?
nanu akusalaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
Hañci akusalaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci akusalaṃ ayoniso manasikaroto uppajjati, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Nekkhammasaññāya anantarā kāmasaññā uppajjati, abyāpādasaññāya anantarā byāpādasaññā uppajjati, avihiṃsāsaññāya anantarā vihiṃsāsaññā uppajjati, mettāya anantarā byāpādo uppajjati, karuṇāya anantarā vihiṃsā uppajjati, muditāya anantarā arati uppajjati, upekkhāya anantarā paṭighaṃ uppajjatīti?
Nanu yasmiññeva vatthusmiṃ rajjati tasmiññeva vatthusmiṃ virajjati, yasmiññeva vatthusmiṃ virajjati tasmiññeva vatthusmiṃ rajjatīti?
Hañci yasmiññeva vatthusmiṃ rajjati tasmiññeva vatthusmiṃ virajjati, yasmiññeva vatthusmiṃ virajjati tasmiññeva vatthusmiṃ rajjati, tena vata re vattabbe—
Upapattesiyena cittena hatthā saṇṭhanti, pādā saṇṭhanti, sīsaṃ saṇṭhāti, kaṇṇo saṇṭhāti, nāsikā saṇṭhāti, mukhaṃ saṇṭhāti, dantā saṇṭhantīti?
Upapattesiyena cittena hatthā saṇṭhanti, pādā saṇṭhanti, sīsaṃ saṇṭhāti, kaṇṇo saṇṭhāti, nāsikā saṇṭhāti, mukhaṃ saṇṭhāti, dantā saṇṭhantīti?
Mātukucchigatassa pacchā kesā lomā nakhā dantā aṭṭhī uppajjantīti?
“mātukucchigatassa pacchā kesā lomā nakhā dantā aṭṭhī uppajjantī”ti?
Tena hi mātukucchigatassa pacchā kesā lomā nakhā dantā aṭṭhī uppajjantīti.
Yā cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sāva sotaviññāṇassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Cakkhuviññāṇassa anantarā sotaviññāṇaṃ uppajjati, na vattabbaṃ—
“yā cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sāva sotaviññāṇassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī”ti?
Nanu sotaviññāṇaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
Hañci sotaviññāṇaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇanti?
Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇanti?
Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇanti?
Hañci “cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇan”ti—
attheva suttanto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Yā jivhāviññāṇassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sāva kāyaviññāṇassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
jivhāviññāṇassa anantarā kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajjati, na vattabbaṃ—
“yā jivhāviññāṇassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, sāva kāyaviññāṇassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhī”ti?
nanu kāyaviññāṇaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
Hañci kāyaviññāṇaṃ āvaṭṭentassa uppajjati …pe… paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇanti?
Jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇanti?
Jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇanti?
Hañci “jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇan”ti—
attheva suttantoti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu atthi koci naccati gāyati vādeti, rūpañca passati, saddañca suṇāti, gandhañca ghāyati, rasañca sāyati, phoṭṭhabbañca phusatīti?
Hañci atthi koci naccati gāyati vādeti, rūpañca passati, saddañca suṇāti, gandhañca ghāyati, rasañca sāyati, phoṭṭhabbañca phusati, tena vata re vattabbe—
Ariyarūpaṃ anāsavaṃ asaṃyojaniyaṃ aganthaniyaṃ anoghaniyaṃ ayoganiyaṃ anīvaraṇiyaṃ aparāmaṭṭhaṃ anupādāniyaṃ asaṅkilesiyanti?
“yaṃ kiñci, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ cattāri mahābhūtāni catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāyarūpan”ti.
Tena hi añño anusayo aññaṃ pariyuṭṭhānanti.
Tena hi añño rāgo aññaṃ pariyuṭṭhānanti.
Natthi sarāgaṃ cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittaṃ samohaṃ cittaṃ …pe…
nanu atthi sarāgaṃ cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittaṃ samohaṃ cittaṃ …pe…
Hañci atthi sarāgaṃ cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittaṃ samohaṃ cittaṃ …pe…
akusalaṃ cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Samāpattesiyo upapattesiyo diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro, samāpattesiyena cittena upapattesiyena cittena diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārena cittena sahagato sahajāto saṃsaṭṭho sampayutto ekuppādo ekanirodho ekavatthuko ekārammaṇoti?

nanu na samāpattesiyo na upapattesiyo na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro, na samāpattesiyena cittena na upapattesiyena cittena na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārena cittena sahagato sahajāto saṃsaṭṭho sampayutto ekuppādo ekanirodho ekavatthuko ekārammaṇoti?
Hañci na samāpattesiyo na upapattesiyo na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro …pe… ekārammaṇo, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Samāpattesiyo upapattesiyo diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro, samāpattesiyena cittena upapattesiyena cittena diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārena cittena sahagato sahajāto saṃsaṭṭho sampayutto ekuppādo ekanirodho ekavatthuko ekārammaṇoti?
Nanu na samāpattesiyo na upapattesiyo na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro, na samāpattesiyena cittena …pe… ekārammaṇoti?
ekārammaṇo, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“rūparāgo rūpadhātuṃ anuseti rūpadhātupariyāpanno, arūparāgo arūpadhātuṃ anuseti arūpadhātupariyāpanno”ti?
Hañci kāmarāgo kāmadhātuṃ anuseti kāmadhātupariyāpanno, tena vata re vattabbe—
“rūparāgo rūpadhātuṃ anuseti rūpadhātupariyāpanno, arūparāgo arūpadhātuṃ anuseti arūpadhātupariyāpanno”ti.
diṭṭhigatasampayuttā vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ akusalanti?
Hañci saphalaṃ savipākaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci micchādiṭṭhiparamāni vajjāni vuttāni bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ, puṇṇa, dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi—
‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti kho, vaccha …pe…
‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti kho, vaccha …pe…
‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti kho, vaccha, abyākatametan”ti.

“micchādiṭṭhikassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa yañceva kāyakammaṃ yathādiṭṭhisamattaṃ samādinnaṃ, yañca vacīkammaṃ …pe… yañca manokammaṃ, yā ca cetanā, yā ca patthanā, yo ca paṇidhi, ye ca saṅkhārā, sabbe te dhammā aniṭṭhāya akantāya amanāpāya ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantī”ti.

Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmimaggo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmimaggo anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattamaggo arahattaphalaṃ, satipaṭṭhānaṃ sammappadhānaṃ iddhipādo indriyaṃ balaṃ bojjhaṅgoti?
Atthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ, amoho kusalamūlaṃ, saddhā vīriyaṃ sati samādhi paññāti?
natthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ …pe… paññāti?
Hañci natthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ, amoho kusalamūlaṃ, saddhā vīriyaṃ sati samādhi paññā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Atthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittanti?
natthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittanti?
sacittakassa maggabhāvanā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Ye keci saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjanti, sabbe te asaññasattupikāti?
Hañci idhāpi asaññī tatrāpi asaññī, tena vata re vattabbe—
Kusalena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo kusaloti, na hevaṃ vattabbe …pe….
Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttoti?
adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttoti?
Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttoti?
adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttena kammena sahajāto kammūpacayo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttoti?
Kammaṃ cittena sahajātaṃ, cittaṃ bhijjamānaṃ kammaṃ bhijjatīti?
Kammūpacayo cittena sahajāto, cittaṃ bhijjamānaṃ kammūpacayo bhijjatīti?
Kammūpacayo cittena sahajāto, cittaṃ bhijjamānaṃ kammūpacayo na bhijjatīti?
Kammaṃ cittena sahajātaṃ, cittaṃ bhijjamānaṃ kammaṃ na bhijjatīti?
Taññeva kammaṃ, so kammūpacayo, so kammavipākoti?
Kammamhi kammūpacayo, kammūpacayato vipāko nibbattati, vipāko sārammaṇoti?
“idha, puṇṇa, ekacco sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vacīsaṅkhāraṃ …pe…
manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, so sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vacīsaṅkhāraṃ …pe…
manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi lokaṃ upapajjati.
Tamenaṃ sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyābajjhāpi abyābajjhāpi phassā phusanti.
So sabyābajjhehipi abyābajjhehipi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vedanaṃ vedeti vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṃ, seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
Iti kho, puṇṇa, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti, yaṃ karoti tena upapajjati, upapannametaṃ phassā phusanti.
Nanu vīmaṃsā hetu, so ca adhipatīti?
Hañci vīmaṃsā hetu, so ca adhipati, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci chandādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci vīriyādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu vīriyādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca indriyanti?
Hañci vīriyādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca indriyaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu vīriyādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca maggaṅganti?
Hañci vīriyādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca maggaṅgaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci cittādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu cittādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, so ca āhāroti?
Hañci cittādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, so ca āhāro, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu cittādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca indriyanti?
Hañci cittādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca indriyaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci vīmaṃsādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu vīmaṃsādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca indriyanti?
Hañci vīmaṃsādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca indriyaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu vīmaṃsādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca maggaṅganti?
Hañci vīmaṃsādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañca maggaṅgaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu ariyaṃ dhammaṃ garuṃ katvā uppajjati paccavekkhaṇā, tañcārammaṇanti?
Hañci ariyaṃ dhammaṃ garuṃ katvā uppajjati paccavekkhaṇā, tañcārammaṇaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu purimā purimā kusalā dhammā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo, sā ca āsevanāti?
Hañci purimā purimā kusalā dhammā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo, sā ca āsevanā, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu purimā purimā akusalā dhammā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo, sā ca āsevanāti?
Hañci purimā purimā akusalā dhammā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo, sā ca āsevanā, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu purimā purimā kiriyābyākatā dhammā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ dhammānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo, sā ca āsevanāti?
Hañci purimā purimā kiriyābyākatā dhammā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kiriyābyākatānaṃ dhammānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo, sā ca āsevanā, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hetupaccayena paccayo hoti, ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo hoti, anantarapaccayena paccayo hoti, samanantarapaccayena paccayo hotīti?
Hañci avijjā saṅkhārena sahajātā, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci taṇhā upādānena sahajātā, tena vata re vattabbe—
Tena hi avijjāpaccayāva saṅkhārā, na vattabbaṃ—
Tena hi avijjāpaccayāpi saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayāpi avijjā;
Atītaṃ rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṅkhārā viññāṇaṃ atīto addhāti?
anāgataṃ rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṅkhārā viññāṇaṃ anāgato addhāti?
paccuppannaṃ rūpaṃ vedanā saññā saṅkhārā viññāṇaṃ paccuppanno addhāti?
Atītā pañcakkhandhā atīto addhā, anāgatā pañcakkhandhā anāgato addhā, paccuppannā pañcakkhandhā paccuppanno addhāti?
Atītāni dvādasāyatanāni atīto addhā, anāgatāni dvādasāyatanāni anāgato addhā, paccuppannāni dvādasāyatanāni paccuppanno addhāti?
Atītā aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo atīto addhā, anāgatā aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo anāgato addhā, paccuppannā aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo paccuppanno addhāti?
Atītāni bāvīsatindriyāni atīto addhā, anāgatāni bāvīsatindriyāni anāgato addhā, paccuppannāni bāvīsatindriyāni paccuppanno addhāti?
Atītaṃ vā, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya—
anāgataṃ vā, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya—
etarahi vā, bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya—
Khaṇo parinipphanno, layo parinipphanno, muhuttaṃ parinipphannanti?
Atītaṃ vā, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya—
anāgataṃ vā, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya—
etarahi vā, bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ ārabbha kathaṃ katheyya—
Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ …pe… bojjhaṅgoti?
Atthaññeva āsavā yehi āsavehi te āsavā sāsavā hontīti?

Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ …pe… bojjhaṅgoti?
Atthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa māraṇantiyo phasso, māraṇantiyā vedanā, māraṇantiyā saññā, māraṇantiyā cetanā, māraṇantiyaṃ cittanti?
natthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa māraṇantiyo phasso, māraṇantiyā vedanā, māraṇantiyā saññā, māraṇantiyā cetanā, māraṇantiyaṃ cittanti?
Hañci natthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa māraṇantiyo phasso, māraṇantiyā vedanā, māraṇantiyā saññā, māraṇantiyā cetanā, māraṇantiyaṃ cittaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Atthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittanti?
natthi saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittanti?
Aphassakassa kālaṅkiriyā, avedanakassa kālaṅkiriyā …pe… acittakassa kālaṅkiriyāti?
Hañci saphassakassa kālaṅkiriyā …pe… sacittakassa kālaṅkiriyā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa kāye visaṃ kameyya, satthaṃ kameyya, aggi kameyyāti?
saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa kāye visaṃ na kameyya, satthaṃ na kameyya, aggi na kameyyāti?
Hañci saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa kāye visaṃ na kameyya, satthaṃ na kameyya, aggi na kameyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa kāye visaṃ kameyya, satthaṃ kameyya, aggi kameyyāti?
Atthi so niyāmo yena niyāmena niyato saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno na kālaṃ kareyyāti?
Hañci natthi so niyāmo yena niyāmena niyato saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno na kālaṃ kareyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Atthi so niyāmo yena niyāmena niyato cakkhuviññāṇasamaṅgī na kālaṃ kareyyāti?
Hañci natthi so niyāmo yena niyāmena niyato cakkhuviññāṇasamaṅgī na kālaṃ kareyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—

nanu na samāpattesiyo na upapattesiyo na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro, na samāpattesiyena cittena …pe… ekavatthuko ekārammaṇoti?
Hañci na samāpattesiyo na upapattesiyo na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro, na samāpattesiyena cittena …pe… ekavatthuko ekārammaṇo, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Hañci na samāpattesiyo na upapattesiyo na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāro, na samāpattesiyena cittena na upapattesiyena cittena na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārena cittena sahagato sahajāto saṃsaṭṭho sampayutto ekuppādo ekanirodho ekavatthuko ekārammaṇo, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Cittaniggaho, cittapaggaho, sukhānuppadānaṃ, adhigayha manasikāro, rūpaṃ hetu, rūpaṃ sahetukaṃ, rūpaṃ kusalampi akusalampi, rūpaṃ vipāko, atthi rūpaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ atthi rūpaṃ arūpāvacaraṃ, sabbe kilesā kāmadhātupariyāpannāti.
Paro parassa cittaṃ “mā rajji”, “mā dussi”, “mā muyhi”, “mā kilissī”ti niggaṇhātīti?

Paro parassa atthāya dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Añño aññassa kārako, paraṅkataṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedetīti?
Hañci atthi balappattā, atthi vasībhūtā, tena vata re vattabbe—
Paro parassa cittaṃ “mā rajji”, “mā dussi”, “mā muyhi”, “mā kilissī”ti paggaṇhātīti?

Hañci atthi balappattā, atthi vasībhūtā, tena vata re vattabbe—

Hañci paro parassa nevattano, na aññesaṃ, na tassa sukhaṃ anuppadeti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Añño aññassa kārako, paraṅkataṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedetīti?

anāgataṃ “anāgatan”ti manasikaronto, atītaṃ “atītan”ti manasi karoti, paccuppannaṃ “paccuppannan”ti manasi karotīti?
Paccuppannaṃ “paccuppannan”ti manasikaronto, atītaṃ “atītan”ti manasi karoti, anāgataṃ “anāgatan”ti manasi karotīti?
paccuppannaṃ “paccuppannan”ti manasikaronto, atītaṃ “atītan”ti manasi karoti, anāgataṃ “anāgatan”ti manasi karotīti?

Hañci mahābhūtā upādāyarūpānaṃ upādāyahetu, tena vata re vattabbe—
nanu anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?
Hañci anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhi, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Hañci rūpaṃ sappaccayaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—

anottappaṃ akusalaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?

Hañci kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ kusalampi akusalampi, tena vata re vattabbe—
Rūpaṃ sukhavedaniyaṃ dukkhavedaniyaṃ adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṃ, sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ, dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ, adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ, phassena sampayuttaṃ …pe…
cittena sampayuttaṃ, sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā …pe… paṇidhīti?

Phasso vipāko, phasso na sukhavedaniyo na dukkhavedaniyo …pe…
Nanu kammassa katattā uppannā cittacetasikā dhammā vipākoti?
Hañci kammassa katattā uppannā cittacetasikā dhammā vipāko, tena vata re vattabbe—

Samāpattesiyaṃ upapattesiyaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ, samāpattesiyena cittena upapattesiyena cittena diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārena cittena sahagataṃ sahajātaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ sampayuttaṃ ekuppādaṃ ekanirodhaṃ ekavatthukaṃ ekārammaṇanti?

nanu na samāpattesiyaṃ na upapattesiyaṃ na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ, na samāpattesiyena cittena na upapattesiyena cittena na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārena cittena sahagataṃ sahajātaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ sampayuttaṃ ekuppādaṃ ekanirodhaṃ ekavatthukaṃ ekārammaṇanti?
Hañci na samāpattesiyaṃ na upapattesiyaṃ na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ, na samāpattesiyena cittena …pe…
ekārammaṇaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Samāpattesiyaṃ upapattesiyaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ, samāpattesiyena cittena upapattesiyena cittena diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārena cittena sahagataṃ sahajātaṃ saṃsaṭṭhaṃ sampayuttaṃ ekuppādaṃ ekanirodhaṃ ekavatthukaṃ ekārammaṇanti?
nanu na samāpattesiyaṃ na upapattesiyaṃ na diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ, na samāpattesiyena cittena …pe…
ekavatthukaṃ ekārammaṇaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci kāmāvacarakammassa katattā rūpaṃ kāmāvacaraṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
“rūpāvacarakammassa katattā rūpaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ, arūpāvacarakammassa katattā rūpaṃ arūpāvacaran”ti.
Nanu bhagavā dvipadānaṃ aggo, dvipadānaṃ seṭṭho, dvipadānaṃ pamokkho, dvipadānaṃ uttamo, dvipadānaṃ pavaro asamo asamasamo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggaloti?
Hañci bhagavā dvipadānaṃ aggo, dvipadānaṃ seṭṭho, dvipadānaṃ pamokkho, dvipadānaṃ uttamo, dvipadānaṃ pavaro asamo asamasamo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo, tena vata re vattabbe—
sīlena samādhinā paññāya, tena vata re vattabbe—
Buddhena seṭṭho ca samo ca vijjati;
Na vattabbaṃ buddhassa dinnaṃ mahapphalantikathā niṭṭhitā.
Nanu atthi keci paṭiggāhakā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti?
Hañci atthi keci paṭiggāhakā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu cattāro purisayugā aṭṭha purisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā bhagavatāti?
Hañci cattāro purisayugā aṭṭha purisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu atthi keci sotāpanne dānaṃ datvā dakkhiṇaṃ ārādhentīti?
Hañci atthi keci sotāpanne dānaṃ datvā dakkhiṇaṃ ārādhenti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci atthi keci arahato dānaṃ datvā dakkhiṇaṃ ārādhenti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Añño aññassa kārako, parakataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedetīti?
Atthānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati, no paṭiggāhakato;

Imā kho, ānanda, catasso dakkhiṇā visuddhiyo”ti.

Hañci arahā neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Hañci yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā—
“anindriyabaddhaṃ aniccaṃ”, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Yathā indriyabaddhassa dukkhassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati, evamevaṃ anindriyabaddhassa dukkhassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti?
yathā indriyabaddhaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ na puna uppajjati, evamevaṃ anindriyabaddhaṃ dukkhaṃ pariññātaṃ na puna uppajjatīti?

Na vattabbaṃ saṅgho dakkhiṇaṃ paṭiggaṇhātītikathā niṭṭhitā.
Nanu saṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti?

Hañci cattāro purisayugā aṭṭha purisapuggalā dakkhiṇeyyā vuttā bhagavatā, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu atthi keci saṅghassa dānaṃ datvā dakkhiṇaṃ ārādhentīti?
Hañci atthi keci saṅghassa dānaṃ datvā dakkhiṇaṃ ārādhenti, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu atthi keci saṅghassa cīvaraṃ datvā …pe…

Hañci atthi keci saṅghabhattāni karonti, uddesabhattāni karonti, yāgupānāni karonti, tena vata re vattabbe—

Nanu atthi buddhavutthāni cetiyāni ārāmavihāragāmanigamanagarāni raṭṭhāni janapadānīti?
Hañci atthi buddhavutthāni cetiyāni ārāmavihāragāmanigamanagarāni raṭṭhāni janapadāni, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu bhagavā lumbiniyā jāto, bodhiyā mūle abhisambuddho, bārāṇasiyaṃ bhagavatā dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ, cāpāle cetiye āyusaṅkhāro ossaṭṭho, kusinārāyaṃ bhagavā parinibbutoti?
Hañci bhagavā lumbiniyā jāto …pe… kusinārāyaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto, tena vata re vattabbe—

Sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā vedanā kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassaupāyāsāti?

Aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ, aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ, tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.

Rūparāgaṃ, arūparāgaṃ, mānaṃ, uddhaccaṃ, avijjaṃ, tadekaṭṭhe ca kilese catubhāgaṃ jahatīti.

tamenaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā uddhampādaṃ adhosiraṃ ṭhapetvā vāsīhi tacchanti …pe…
tamenaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā rathe yojetvā ādittāya pathaviyā sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya sārentipi paccāsārentipi …pe…
tamenaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā mahantaṃ aṅgārapabbataṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ āropentipi oropentipi …pe…
tamenaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā uddhampādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya.
So tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccati, so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakimpi uddhaṃ gacchati, sakimpi adho gacchati, sakimpi tiriyaṃ gacchati.
So tattha dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vedayati, na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
Atthi tattha kīṭā paṭaṅgā makasā makkhikā ahī vicchikā satapadī gaṇḍuppādāti?
Nanu atthi tattha erāvaṇo nāma hatthināgo sahassayuttaṃ dibbaṃ yānanti?
Hañci atthi tattha erāvaṇo nāma hatthināgo sahassayuttaṃ dibbaṃ yānaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe—
Atthi tattha hatthibandhā assabandhā yāvasikā kāraṇikā bhattakārakāti?
Nanu aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vutto bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ—
Hañci aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vutto bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ—
sammādiṭṭhi …pe… sammāsamādhi, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Sammāvācā maggaṅgaṃ, sā ca na maggoti?
Sammādiṭṭhi maggaṅgaṃ, sā ca na maggoti?
sammāvācā maggaṅgaṃ, sā ca na maggoti?
sammāsamādhi maggaṅgaṃ, so ca na maggoti?
sammāājīvo maggaṅgaṃ, so ca na maggoti?
sammādiṭṭhi …pe… sammāsamādhi maggaṅgaṃ, so ca na maggoti?
“pubbeva kho panassa kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ ājīvo suparisuddho hoti;
evamassāyaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatī”ti.

“yasmiṃ kho, subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo na upalabbhati, samaṇopi tattha na upalabbhati, dutiyopi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati, tatiyopi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati, catutthopi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati.
Yasmiñca kho, subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo upalabbhati, samaṇopi tattha upalabbhati, dutiyopi …pe… tatiyopi …pe… catutthopi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati.
Imasmiṃ kho, subhadda, dhammavinaye ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo upalabbhati. Idheva, subhadda, samaṇo, idha dutiyo samaṇo, idha tatiyo samaṇo, idha catuttho samaṇo. Suññā parappavādā samaṇebhi aññehī”ti.
“‘idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan’ti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
‘Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyan’ti me, bhikkhave …pe…
‘taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pahātabban’ti me, bhikkhave …pe…
‘taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabban’ti me, bhikkhave …pe…
‘taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabban’ti me, bhikkhave …pe…
bhāvitanti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi …pe…

Mātughātako ānantariko pitughātako ānantariko arahantaghātako ānantariko ruhiruppādako ānantariko saṅghabhedako ānantariko, natthi puthujjanassa ñāṇaṃ, natthi nirayesu nirayapālā, atthi devesu tiracchānagatā, pañcaṅgiko maggo, dvādasavatthukaṃ ñāṇaṃ lokuttaranti.
Niggaho, puññasañcayo, aṭṭhāsi, atītena ca mātughātako.
pubbe sāsavaṃ …pe… saṃyojaniyaṃ ganthaniyaṃ oghaniyaṃ yoganiyaṃ nīvaraṇiyaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ upādāniyaṃ …pe… saṅkilesiyaṃ pacchā asaṅkilesiyaṃ katanti?
Atthi koci tathāgatassa sāsanaṃ navaṃ karotīti?
atthi koci pubbe akusalaṃ pacchā kusalaṃ karotīti?
atthi koci pubbe sāsavaṃ …pe… saṅkilesiyaṃ pacchā asaṅkilesiyaṃ karotīti?
Labbhā tathāgatassa sāsanaṃ puna navaṃ kātunti?
labbhā pubbe akusalaṃ pacchā kusalaṃ kātunti?
labbhā pubbe sāsavaṃ …pe… saṅkilesiyaṃ pacchā asaṅkilesiyaṃ kātunti?
Yasmiṃ khaṇe puthujjano cīvaraṃ deti, tasmiṃ khaṇe paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ deti, tasmiṃ khaṇe catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati …
Tena hi puthujjano tedhātukehi kammehi avivittoti …pe….
Arahā sarāgo sadoso samoho samāno samakkho sapaḷāso saupāyāso sakilesoti?
nanu arahā nirāgo niddoso nimmoho nimmāno nimmakkho nippaḷāso nirupāyāso nikkilesoti?
nikkileso, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Tena hi atthi kiñci saṃyojanaṃ appahāya arahattappattīti.
Atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
Atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
Atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
Atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
atthi adhippāyaiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vāti?
Nanu āyasmā pilindavaccho rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa pāsādaṃ “suvaṇṇan”tveva adhimucci, suvaṇṇo ca pana āsīti?
Hañci āyasmā pilindavaccho rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa pāsādaṃ “suvaṇṇan”tveva adhimucci, suvaṇṇo ca pana āsi, tena vata re vattabbe—

Kiṃnāmo so bhagavā, kiṃjacco, kiṅgotto, kiṃnāmā tassa bhagavato mātāpitaro, kiṃnāmaṃ tassa bhagavato sāvakayugaṃ, konāmo tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhāko, kīdisaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti, kīdisaṃ pattaṃ dhāreti, katarasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā nagare vā raṭṭhe vā janapade vāti?
Hañci atthi aniyato rāsi, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“micchattaniyato rāsi, sammattaniyato rāsi, aniyato rāsi”, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Tena hi rūpaṃ rūpaṭṭhena niyataṃ, vedanā …pe…
Hañci atthi aniyato rāsi, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“micchattaniyato rāsi, sammattaniyato rāsi, aniyato rāsi”, no ca vata re vattabbe—
diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṭṭhena niyataṃ, upapajjavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ …pe…
Diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ upapajjavedanīyaṃ hoti, aparāpariyavedanīyaṃ hoti …pe…
upapajjavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, aparāpariyavedanīyaṃ hoti …pe…
aparāpariyavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, upapajjavedanīyaṃ hotīti?
Tena hi diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṭṭhena niyataṃ, upapajjavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ …pe…

Sāsanaṃ navaṃ kataṃ atthi koci tathāgatassa sāsanaṃ navaṃ karoti labbhā tathāgatassa sāsanaṃ puna navaṃ kātuṃ, puthujjano tedhātukehi kammehi avivitto, atthi kiñci saṃyojanaṃ appahāya arahattappatti, atthi adhippāyiddhi buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vā, atthi buddhānaṃ buddhehi hīnātirekatā, sabbā disā buddhā tiṭṭhanti, sabbe dhammā niyatā, sabbe kammā niyatāti.
Atthi kiñci sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ appahāya …pe… anottappaṃ appahāya parinibbānanti?
Hañci arahā nirāgo …pe… nikkileso, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Tena hi atthi kiñci saṃyojanaṃ appahāya parinibbānanti.
Arahā ācinanto apacinanto pajahanto upādiyanto visinento ussinento vidhūpento sandhūpento parinibbāyatīti?
nanu arahā nevācināti na apacināti apacinitvā ṭhitoti?
Hañci arahā nevācināti na apacināti apacinitvā ṭhito, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu arahā neva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito, neva visineti na ussineti visinetvā ṭhito;
nanu arahā neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhitoti?
Hañci arahā neva vidhūpeti na sandhūpeti vidhūpetvā ṭhito, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu arahā upaṭṭhitassati sato sampajāno parinibbāyatīti?
Hañci arahā upaṭṭhitassati sato sampajāno parinibbāyati, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci arahā pakaticitte ṭhito parinibbāyati, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci arahā vipākacitte ṭhito parinibbāyati, no ca vata re vattabbe—
nanu arahā vipākābyākate citte ṭhito parinibbāyatīti?
Hañci arahā vipākābyākate citte ṭhito parinibbāyati, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu bhagavā catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā samanantarā parinibbutoti?
Hañci bhagavā catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā samanantarā parinibbuto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Atthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā, dhammassavanaṃ, dhammasākacchā, paripucchā, sīlasamādānaṃ, indriyesu guttadvāratā, bhojane mattaññutā, pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogoti?
natthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā, dhammassavanaṃ …pe… pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogoti?
Hañci natthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā, dhammassavanaṃ …pe… pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogo, no ca vata re vattabbe—
parato ca ghoso, yoniso ca manasikāroti?
parato ca ghoso, yoniso ca manasikāro, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci supinantena pāṇaṃ haneyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci supinantena cetiyaṃ abhidakkhiṇaṃ kareyya, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu supinagatassa cittaṃ abbohāriyaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti?
Hañci supinagatassa cittaṃ abbohāriyaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, tena vata re vattabbe—

“pāṇātipāto, bhikkhave, āsevito bhāvito bahulīkato nirayasaṃvattaniko tiracchānayonisaṃvattaniko pettivisayasaṃvattaniko, yo sabbalahuso pāṇātipātassa vipāko manussabhūtassa appāyukasaṃvattaniko hotī”ti.

“adinnādānaṃ, bhikkhave, āsevitaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ nirayasaṃvattanikaṃ tiracchānayonisaṃvattanikaṃ pettivisayasaṃvattanikaṃ, yo sabbalahuso adinnādānassa vipāko manussabhūtassa bhogabyasanasaṃvattaniko hoti …pe…
yo sabbalahuso kāmesumicchācārassa vipāko manussabhūtassa sapattaverasaṃvattaniko hoti …pe…
yo sabbalahuso musāvādassa vipāko manussabhūtassa abbhūtabbhakkhānasaṃvattaniko hoti …pe…
yo sabbalahuso pisuṇāya vācāya vipāko manussabhūtassa mittehi bhedanasaṃvattaniko hoti …pe…
yo sabbalahuso pharusāya vācāya vipāko manussabhūtassa amanāpasaddasaṃvattaniko hoti …pe…
yo sabbalahuso samphappalāpassa vipāko manussabhūtassa anādeyyavācāsaṃvattaniko hoti, surāmerayapānaṃ, bhikkhave, āsevitaṃ …pe…
yo sabbalahuso surāmerayapānassa vipāko manussabhūtassa ummattakasaṃvattaniko hotī”ti.
“micchādiṭṭhi, bhikkhave, āsevitā bhāvitā bahulīkatā nirayasaṃvattanikā tiracchānayonisaṃvattanikā pettivisayasaṃvattanikā”ti.
“sammādiṭṭhi, bhikkhave, āsevitā bhāvitā bahulīkatā amatogadhā hoti amataparāyanā amatapariyosānā”ti.
sammāsamādhi, bhikkhave, āsevito bhāvito bahulīkato amatogadho hoti amataparāyano amatapariyosāno”ti.
Citte mahāpathavī saṇṭhāti, mahāsamuddo saṇṭhāti, sinerupabbatarājā saṇṭhāti, āpo saṇṭhāti, tejo saṇṭhāti, vāyo saṇṭhāti, tiṇakaṭṭhavanappatayo saṇṭhahantīti?
“ajjhattikañceva, āvuso, cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, neva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.
Ajjhattikañceva, āvuso, cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, neva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.
Yato ca kho, āvuso, ajjhattikañceva cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, tajjo ca samannāhāro hoti, evaṃ tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hotī”ti.
“ajjhattiko ceva, āvuso, kāyo aparibhinno hoti, bāhirā ca phoṭṭhabbā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca …pe…
ajjhattiko ceva, āvuso, kāyo aparibhinno hoti, bāhirā ca phoṭṭhabbā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca …pe…
yato ca kho, āvuso, ajjhattiko ceva kāyo aparibhinno hoti, bāhirā ca phoṭṭhabbā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, tajjo ca samannāhāro hoti, evaṃ tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hotī”ti.
Sabbe dhammā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammāti?
Ekādhippāyena assamaṇena hotabbaṃ, abhikkhunā hotabbaṃ, chinnamūlena hotabbaṃ pārājikena hotabbanti?
Arahantānaṃ vaṇṇena amanussā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevantīti?
nattheva suttanto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Bodhisatto issariyakāmakārikāhetu nirayaṃ upapajjeyya, tiracchānayoniṃ upapajjeyyāti?
nattheva suttanto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti …pe…
“neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti paccāgacchīti?
nattheva suttanto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Bodhisatto issariyakāmakārikāhetu aparantapaṃ akāsi, aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisīti?
“neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti paccāgacchīti?
nattheva suttanto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Rūpaṃ na aniccaṃ na saṅkhataṃ na paṭiccasamuppannaṃ na khayadhammaṃ na vayadhammaṃ na virāgadhammaṃ na nirodhadhammaṃ na vipariṇāmadhammanti?
nanu rūpaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti?
vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā—
Hañci yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā—
“rūpaṃ aniccaṃ”, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci aññātāvindriyaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā—
Hañci yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā—
“aññātāvindriyaṃ aniccaṃ”, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Ekādhippāyena methuno dhammo paṭisevitabbo, arahantānaṃ vaṇṇena amanussā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti, bodhisatto issariyakāmakārikāhetu vinipātaṃ gacchati, gabbhaseyyaṃ okkamati, dukkarakārikaṃ akāsi, aparantapaṃ akāsi, aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisi, atthi na rāgo rāgapatirūpako, atthi na doso dosapatirūpako, atthi na moho mohapatirūpako atthi na kileso kilesapatirūpako, rūpaṃ aparinipphannaṃ aññātāvindriyaṃ aparinipphannanti.
Nanu asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaroti?
Atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlanti?
Hañci asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro, tena vata re vattabbe—
“atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan”ti.
‘asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro’, no ca vattabbe—
‘atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan’”ti micchā.
“atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan”ti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“vattabbe kho ‘asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro’, no ca vattabbe—
‘atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlan’”ti micchā.
Atthi manussesu saṃvaro, atthi tattha asaṃvaroti?
Atthi devesu saṃvaro, atthi tattha asaṃvaroti?
Atthi devesu saṃvaro, natthi tattha asaṃvaroti?
Atthi manussesu saṃvaro, natthi tattha asaṃvaroti?
Atthi manussesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇi, atthi tattha pāṇātipātoti?
Atthi devesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇi, atthi tattha pāṇātipātoti?
Atthi manussesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇi, atthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti?
Atthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇi, atthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti?
Atthi devesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇi, natthi tattha pāṇātipātoti?
Atthi manussesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇi, natthi tattha pāṇātipātoti?
Atthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇi, natthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti?
Atthi manussesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇi, natthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti?
Sabbe devā pāṇātipātino adinnādāyino kāmesumicchācārino musāvādino surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyinoti?
Saññābhavo saññāgati saññāsattāvāso saññāsaṃsāro saññāyoni saññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti?
Nanu asaññabhavo asaññagati asaññasattāvāso asaññasaṃsāro asaññayoni asaññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti?
Hañci asaññabhavo asaññagati asaññasattāvāso asaññasaṃsāro asaññayoni asaññattabhāvapaṭilābho, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Pañcavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti?
Nanu ekavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti?
Hañci ekavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābho, no ca vata re vattabbe—

Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi somanassaṃ, atthi somanassindriyaṃ, atthi jīvitaṃ, atthi jīvitindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, atthi saddhindriyanti?
aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi jīvitaṃ, atthi jīvitindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, natthi saddhindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi mano, natthi manindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, natthi saddhindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi somanassaṃ, natthi somanassindriyanti …pe… atthi jīvitaṃ, natthi jīvitindriyanti?
aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi paññā, natthi paññindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi mano, natthi manindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, sā ca saddhā niyyānikāti?
Hañci aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, sā ca saddhā niyyānikā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi vīriyaṃ, tañca vīriyaṃ niyyānikaṃ;
atthi sati, sā ca sati niyyānikā;
atthi samādhi, so ca samādhi niyyāniko;
atthi paññā, sā ca paññā niyyānikāti?
Hañci aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi paññā, sā ca paññā niyyānikā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, atthi saddhindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, atthi saddhindriyanti?
sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa atthi paññā, atthi paññindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi paññā, atthi paññindriyanti?
arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, atthi saddhindriyaṃ …pe…
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi paññā, atthi paññindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, natthi saddhindriyanti?
Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, natthi saddhindriyanti?
aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi paññā, natthi paññindriyanti?
Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa atthi paññā, natthi paññindriyanti?
Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi saddhā, natthi saddhindriyanti …pe…
arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa atthi paññā, natthi paññindriyanti?
Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samattā paripūrattā arahā hoti.

Tato mudutarehi arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno hoti, tato mudutarehi anāgāmī hoti, tato mudutarehi anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno hoti, tato mudutarehi sakadāgāmī hoti, tato mudutarehi sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno hoti, tato mudutarehi sotāpanno hoti, tato mudutarehi sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno hoti.
Yassa kho, bhikkhave, imāni pañcindriyāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi, tamahaṃ ‘bāhiro puthujjanapakkhe ṭhito’ti vadāmī”ti.
tena hi aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa atthi pañcindriyānīti.
Yādisaṃ maṃsacakkhuṃ tādisaṃ dibbacakkhuṃ, yādisaṃ dibbacakkhuṃ tādisaṃ maṃsacakkhunti?
Taññeva maṃsacakkhuṃ taṃ dibbacakkhuṃ, taṃ dibbacakkhuṃ taṃ maṃsacakkhunti?
Yādiso maṃsacakkhussa visayo ānubhāvo gocaro tādiso dibbassa cakkhussa visayo ānubhāvo gocaroti?
maṃsacakkhuṃ, dibbacakkhuṃ, paññācakkhuṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Yādisaṃ maṃsasotaṃ tādisaṃ dibbasotaṃ, yādisaṃ dibbasotaṃ tādisaṃ maṃsasotanti?
Taññeva maṃsasotaṃ taṃ dibbasotaṃ, taṃ dibbasotaṃ taṃ maṃsasotanti?
Yādiso maṃsasotassa visayo ānubhāvo gocaro tādiso dibbassa sotassa visayo ānubhāvo gocaroti?
maṃsasotaṃ, dibbasotaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Yathākammūpagatañca manasi karoti, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passatīti?
Yathākammūpagatañca manasi karoti, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passatīti?
Dvinnaṃ phassānaṃ dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ samodhānaṃ hotīti?

“Ime vata bhonto sattā”ti ca manasi karoti, “kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā”ti ca manasi karoti, “vacīduccaritena samannāgatā”ti ca manasi karoti, “manoduccaritena samannāgatā”ti ca manasi karoti, “ariyānaṃ upavādakā”ti ca manasi karoti, “micchādiṭṭhikā”ti ca manasi karoti, “micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā”ti ca manasi karoti, “te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā”ti ca manasi karoti, “ime vā pana bhonto sattā”ti ca manasi karoti, “kāyasucaritena samannāgatā”ti ca manasi karoti, “vacīsucaritena samannāgatā”ti ca manasi karoti, “manosucaritena samannāgatā”ti ca manasi karoti, “ariyānaṃ anupavādakā”ti ca manasi karoti, “sammādiṭṭhikā”ti ca manasi karoti, “sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā”ti ca manasi karoti, “te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā”ti ca manasi karoti, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passatīti?
“Te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā”ti ca manasi karoti, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passatīti?
Dvinnaṃ phassānaṃ dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ samodhānaṃ hotīti?
Atthi koci adibbacakkhuko dibbacakkhuṃ appaṭiladdho anadhigato asacchikato yathākammūpagataṃ jānātīti?
Hañci atthi koci adibbacakkhuko dibbacakkhuṃ appaṭiladdho anadhigato asacchikato yathākammūpagataṃ jānāti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci āyasmā sāriputto yathākammūpagataṃ ñāṇaṃ jānāti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ sotāpattiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti?
Hañci tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ sotāpattiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Arahattamaggena oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ pajahatīti?
Arahattamaggena oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ pajahatīti?
Nanu kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ tanubhāvaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti?
Hañci kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ tanubhāvaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Arahattamaggena aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ pajahatīti?
Arahattamaggena aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ pajahatīti?
Nanu kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ anavasesappahānaṃ anāgāmiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti?
Hañci kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ anavasesappahānaṃ anāgāmiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu rūparāgaarūparāgamānauddhaccaavijjāya anavasesappahānaṃ arahattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti?
Hañci rūparāgaarūparāgamānauddhaccaavijjāya anavasesappahānaṃ arahattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci arahato sabbe saṃyojanā pahīnā, tena vata re vattabbe—

Gihi’ssa arahā, saha upapattiyā arahā, arahato sabbe dhammā anāsavā, arahā catūhi phalehi samannāgato, evamevaṃ chahi upekkhāhi, bodhiyā buddho, salakkhaṇasamannāgato, bodhisatto okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, paṭipannako phalena samannāgato, sabbasaṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ arahattanti.
Hañci natthi arahato gihisaṃyojanaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Nanu arahato gihisaṃyojanaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammanti?
Hañci arahato gihisaṃyojanaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Atthi koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaroti?
Hañci natthi koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro, no ca vata re vattabbe—
“atthi nu kho, bho gotama, koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhassantakaro”ti?
“Natthi kho, vaccha, koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhassantakaro”ti.

Arahā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, methunaṃ uppādeyya, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvaseyya, kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhaveyya, mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhāreyya, jātarūparajataṃ sādiyeyya, ajeḷakaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, hatthigavassavaḷavaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, tittiravaṭṭakamorakapiñjaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, cittavaṇḍavālamoḷiṃ dhāreyya, odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni dhāreyya, yāvajīvaṃ agāriyabhūto assāti?
Nanu yaso kulaputto, uttiyo gahapati, setu māṇavo, gihibyañjanena arahattaṃ pattoti?
Hañci yaso kulaputto, uttiyo gahapati, setu māṇavo, gihibyañjanena arahattaṃ patto, tena vata re vattabbe—
Hañci saha upapattiyā sotāpanno na hoti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci saha upapattiyā sakadāgāmī na hoti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Hañci saha upapattiyā anāgāmī na hoti, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Sāriputto thero na saha upapattiyā arahāti?
Hañci sāriputto thero na saha upapattiyā arahā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
mahāpanthako thero na saha upapattiyā arahāti?
Hañci mahāpanthako thero na saha upapattiyā arahā, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Upapattesiyena cittena arahattaṃ sacchikaroti lokiyena sāsavena …pe… saṅkilesiyenāti?
Upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ niyyānikaṃ khayagāmī bodhagāmī apacayagāmī anāsavaṃ …pe…
Nanu upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ aniyyānikaṃ na khayagāmi na bodhagāmi na apacayagāmi sāsavaṃ …pe…
Hañci upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ aniyyānikaṃ na khayagāmi na bodhagāmi na apacayagāmi sāsavaṃ …pe… saṅkilesiyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Upapattesiyena cittena rāgaṃ pajahati, dosaṃ pajahati, mohaṃ pajahati, anottappaṃ pajahatīti?
Upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ maggo … satipaṭṭhānaṃ …pe… sammappadhānaṃ … iddhipādo … indriyaṃ … balaṃ … bojjhaṅgoti?
Upapattesiyena cittena dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti?

Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmimaggo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmimaggo anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattamaggo arahattaphalaṃ, satipaṭṭhānaṃ sammappadhānaṃ iddhipādo indriyaṃ balaṃ bojjhaṅgoti?
Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ …pe… bojjhaṅgoti?
Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ …pe… bojjhaṅgoti?
Arahato kāyo paggahaniggahupago chedanabhedanupago kākehi gijjhehi kulalehi sādhāraṇoti?
Anāsavo dhammo paggahaniggahupago chedanabhedanupago kākehi gijjhehi kulalehi sādhāraṇoti?
Arahato kāye visaṃ kameyya, satthaṃ kameyya, aggi kameyyāti?
Anāsave dhamme visaṃ kameyya, satthaṃ kameyya, aggi kameyyāti?

Labbhā arahato kāyo addubandhanena bandhituṃ, rajjubandhanena bandhituṃ, saṅkhalikabandhanena bandhituṃ, gāmabandhanena bandhituṃ, nigamabandhanena bandhituṃ, nagarabandhanena bandhituṃ, janapadabandhanena bandhituṃ, kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitunti?
Labbhā anāsavo dhammo addubandhanena bandhituṃ, rajjubandhanena bandhituṃ, saṅkhalikabandhanena bandhituṃ, gāmanigamanagarajanapadabandhanena bandhituṃ, kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitunti?
Yadi arahā puthujjanassa cīvaraṃ deti, anāsavaṃ hutvā sāsavaṃ hotīti?
Yadi arahā puthujjanassa piṇḍapātaṃ deti, senāsanaṃ deti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ deti, anāsavo hutvā sāsavo hotīti?
Yadi puthujjano arahato cīvaraṃ deti, sāsavaṃ hutvā anāsavaṃ hotīti?
Yadi puthujjano arahato piṇḍapātaṃ deti, senāsanaṃ deti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ deti, sāsavo hutvā anāsavo hotīti?
Hañci arahā anāsavo, tena vata re vattabbe—
Arahā catūhi phassehi catūhi vedanāhi catūhi saññāhi catūhi cetanāhi catūhi cittehi catūhi saddhāhi catūhi vīriyehi catūhi satīhi catūhi samādhīhi catūhi paññāhi samannāgatoti?
Anāgāmī tīhi phassehi …pe… tīhi paññāhi samannāgatoti?
Sakadāgāmī dvīhi phassehi …pe… dvīhi paññāhi samannāgatoti?
Arahā anāgāmī, antarāparinibbāyī, upahaccaparinibbāyī, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmīti?
Hañci arahā sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Arahā sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto, sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ rāgaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ dosaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti?
Hañci arahā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Arahā sakadāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ, oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti?
Hañci arahā anāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Arahā anāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ, aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti?
Hañci anāgāmī sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Anāgāmī sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto, sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ …pe… apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti?
Hañci anāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Anāgāmī sakadāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ, oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti?
Hañci sakadāgāmī sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe—
Sakadāgāmī sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto, sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ …pe… apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti?
Nanu arahatā cattāri phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti?
Hañci arahatā cattāri phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīno, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu anāgāminā tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti?
Hañci anāgāminā tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīno, tena vata re vattabbe—
Nanu sakadāgāminā dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti?
Hañci sakadāgāminā dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīno, tena vata re vattabbe—
Arahatā cattāri phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti, arahā catūhi phalehi samannāgatoti?
Arahatā cattāro maggā paṭiladdhā tehi ca aparihīnoti, arahā catūhi maggehi samannāgatoti?
Anāgāminā tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti, anāgāmī tīhi phalehi samannāgatoti?
Anāgāminā tayo maggā paṭiladdhā tehi ca aparihīnoti, anāgāmī tīhi maggehi samannāgatoti?
Sakadāgāminā dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti, sakadāgāmī dvīhi phalehi samannāgatoti?
Sakadāgāminā dve maggā paṭiladdhā tehi ca aparihīnoti, sakadāgāmī dvīhi maggehi samannāgatoti?
Arahā chahi phassehi, chahi vedanāhi, chahi saññāhi …pe… chahi paññāhi samannāgatoti?
Arahā cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanto sotena saddaṃ suṇāti, ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyati, jivhāya rasaṃ sāyati, kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusati, manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti …pe…
manasā dhammaṃ vijānanto cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, sotena saddaṃ suṇāti, ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyati, jivhāya rasaṃ sāyati, kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusatīti?
Satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ chahi upekkhāhi samannāgato samohito, cha upekkhāyo paccupaṭṭhitāti?
Hañci arahā chaḷaṅgupekkho, tena vata re vattabbe—
Bodhiyā niruddhāya vigatāya paṭipassaddhāya abuddho hotīti?
Tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti …pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti?
Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti?
Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti …pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti?
Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti?
Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti …pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti …pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti?
Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti?
Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti …pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti …pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti?
Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti?
Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti …pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti …pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddhoti?
Satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ tīhi bodhīhi samannāgato samohito, tisso bodhiyo paccupaṭṭhitāti?
Hañci bodhipaṭilābhā buddho, tena vata re vattabbe—
Yādiso bodhisattassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanā, tādiso cakkavattisattassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanāti?
Yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti pacchā manussā, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti pacchā manussāti?
Yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti—
Mahesakkho te putto uppanno”ti, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti—
Yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti—
yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu ca, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti—
yena cakkavattisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu cāti?
Yathā sampatijāto bodhisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarena abhimukho sattapadavītihārena gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñca vācaṃ bhāsati—

“aggohamasmi lokassa, jeṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, seṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, ayamantimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo”ti, evamevaṃ sampatijāto cakkavattisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarena abhimukho sattapadavītihārena gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñca vācaṃ bhāsati—
“aggohamasmi lokassa, jeṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, seṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, ayamantimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo”ti?

Yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa mahato ālokassa mahato obhāsassa mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvo hoti, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa mahato ālokassa mahato obhāsassa mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvo hotīti?

Yathā bodhisatto mahāsupinaṃ passati, evamevaṃ cakkavattisatto mahāsupinaṃ passatīti?
“dvattiṃsimāni, bhikkhave, mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
Parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
So imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭṭacchado”ti.

Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako adinnādānaṃ pahāya …pe…
